# RC58 — Typed Open Path

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `Esc w o` / `workspace.open-path` / `Open Path`.
- Added `:open-path [PATH]`, `:edit-path [PATH]`, and `:open [PATH]`.
- Open Path prompts for a typed workspace-contained path when omitted.
- Existing regular files open even when the current buffer is dirty, preserving the dirty source buffer.
- Not-yet-created paths open as clean unsaved file-backed buffers when the parent directory already exists.
- Open Path does not create disk files or parent directories; `Esc w n` / `:new-file` remains the explicit creation flow.
- Workspace-root targets, outside-workspace targets, directory targets, special-file targets, and missing-parent targets are refused visibly.
- Updated README and the real-iPad QA matrix to distinguish Quick Open, Open Path, and New File.
